do.reason: ManaProduction.landCouldProduce cannot say whose lands are read: it carries no player or ObjectFilter, so 'a land an opponent controls' has nowhere to go and the flag alone reads as 'a land you control' (Reflecting Pool), a different card. ManaProduction needs a filter for the lands whose colours are surveyed.
